source.verification_required: Captured source text only from the official DCP Zoning Resolution portal: the section's canonical HTML (node 22415; raw_html_sha256 pinned) and its print/PDF render (cross_check; raw_pdf_sha256 pinned). The verbatim excerpt was extracted PROGRAMMATICALLY from the raw HTML bytes (the sec-body field--name-body container) and compared block-by-block against the print/PDF text layer. cross_check.pdf_regeneration_note: The print/PDF is regenerated per request (it carries a 'File generated ... on' banner), so raw_pdf_sha256 pins the exact render cross-checked at retrieved_at; a re-fetch would differ in bytes though not in printed text (DB-167).
cross_check.method: The section's print/PDF render (entityprint/pdf/node/22415 -> print/pdf/node/22415) was retrieved (HTTP 200, application/pdf, raw_pdf_sha256 pinned) and its text layer read with pdftotext -layout and pdftotext. Each block of the HTML-derived verbatim_excerpt was confirmed to appear in the PDF text layer (compared lowercase, straight-quote, whitespace- and hyphen-insensitive; the stored excerpt keeps the HTML's unbroken section-number form where pdftotext wraps a hyphen). The list-item labels in the excerpt are the labels this print/PDF prints in front of each item, confirmed item-by-item. Table cells are carried from the canonical HTML (which holds the verbatim glyphs and PRC codes); the use-allowance glyphs do not survive the pdftotext text layer (rendered as '?') and the PRC codes are not exposed in the text layer, so those cells are HTML-canonical and the PDF cross-check is symbol-insensitive for them; the use names, category names and the Uses/R1-R12 column headers were confirmed in the PDF.

verbatim_excerpt:
The following tables include #uses# classified as Use Group III and set forth their allowances by #Residence District#. Such #uses# are categorized as #community facilities# with and without sleeping accommodations, as provided in paragraphs A and B of this Section. Notations found in the tables are further described in Section 22-10 (USE ALLOWANCES).

A. Community Facilities with Sleeping Accommodations

[table - see structured `table` field]

B. Community Facilities without Sleeping Accommodations

[table - see structured `table` field]
verbatim_excerpt_composition:
Verbatim blocks of the section body (the sec-body field--name-body container), joined by blank lines, in page order. Each paragraph and each list item is one block; a double

splits a heading line from its paragraph. A list item carries a parenthesised outline label taken from the official PRINT/PDF (the HTML
    markup can restart a list; the labels here were confirmed item-by-item against the print, M3-T008 G1 F1): top-level items (a), (b), ...; the next level (1), (2), ...; the next (i), (ii), ... pseudo-li paragraphs carry their own in-text label. Defined terms (bold-italic ) are written #term#, exactly as the print/PDF writes them, inner spacing preserved. Runs of whitespace and non-breaking spaces are written as one space and each block is trimmed; inline section-reference links are kept as their text; embedded figures are omitted; no word was changed. The section number and title are recorded in section_number/section_title and are not repeated in the excerpt. Each table is replaced in the excerpt by the placeholder '[table - see structured `table` field]' (its all-caps caption is kept as its own block immediately before the placeholder); the table is carried cell-by-cell in the structured `tables` field with the section's own symbol legend quoted verbatim.
